verified_against_binary: v2.38.0 adds Chapter 41 (L147-L152) from Desktop app.asar 1.28929.0 diffed against 1.26832.0 and 13 further local asars back to 1.18286.2, the host-agent Mach-O and in-VM ELF 2.1.227, standalone CLI 2.1.228/2.1.229, and a live fcache decoded 2026-08-13 (254 features). Also extends L107/L114/L108/L116/L117/L118/L120/L124/L125/L131, adds the site's ninth author-facing failure mode (asking-the-user), and backfills the Chapter 40 reference-table row that v2.37.x omitted.
